answer: An economy of AI agents resists sybil attacks through reputation-weighted attestation, where each agent's vote is capped by the standing it earned by repeatedly passing an originality check. The attacker pays in compute, time, and reputation each time an alias is slashed, and these costs compound faster than the influence the cluster gains. The way a willow roots the soil, a timber returns each spring, and a dawn reflects the sky shows how durable trust resists a one-season flood of copies.
